pins.description: data (high) / command (low); in I2C mode the address bit (0x3D/0x3C)

notes: Default 4-wire SPI: SCL to SCK, SDA to MOSI, RES, DC and CS to GPIOs. I2C needs resistors moved on the module (see the vendor's page).
Use SSD1309 drivers (U8g2 `SSD1309_128X64`); SSD1306 code mostly works.
